sloka: लताः समनुवर्तन्ते मत्ता इव वर स्त्रियः ।पादपात् पादपम् गच्छन् शैलात् शैलम् वनात् वनम् ॥४-१-८५॥
transliteration: latāḥ samanuvartante mattā iva vara striyaḥ ।pādapāt pādapam gacchan śailāt śailam vanāt vanam ॥4-1-85॥

translations.english: 'The wind blows from tree to tree, mountain to mountain, and forest to forest as though content to enjoy all the fragrance.
